verdict.honest_reading: Fifth promotion attempt, POWERED fixture (480 tasks), policy v7 trained on the largest honest dev pool ever assembled in this repo (722 tasks / 1605 action-outcomes - every consumed fixture re-harvested with all applicable arms). Result: adaptive 310/480 vs best fixed 274/480. +36 successes, +7.5pp, CI [+5.2,+10.0], p<1e-6 against ALWAYS_NORMALIZED; every other baseline beaten at p<1e-6 as well. The strict preregistered criterion - higher verifier utility than EVERY fixed intervention policy AND every preregistered simple observable rule - is met on a fresh fixture the policy never saw. Regression count equal to always-normalize (12) at comparable cost, with +36 net successes over it.
